neighbours.label: second half of a parallel aphorism: a frame repeated with a contrasting filler (once is X, twice is Y; your X is our Y; those who can, do; those who can't, teach)
fire: Your schedule is our schedule, and your deadline is our deadline.
One mistake is bad luck, two mistakes are a habit.
Those who plan, prosper; those who drift, drown.
Eat to live, don't live to eat.
A good plan today beats a perfect plan tomorrow.
In peace, sons bury their fathers; in war, fathers bury their sons.
quiet: We will adjust our schedule to meet your deadline.
He made two mistakes in the first week and was warned.
People who plan ahead usually do better in business.
She eats a light supper and goes to bed early.
The team failed the first test but learned a lot from it.
The plan was approved today and work starts tomorrow.
He measured the board carefully before cutting it.
In the war, many fathers lost their sons.
